authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) & Legal Metrology

rules.title: Name of Food on Principal Display Panel
rules.name: Name of Food on Principal Display Panel
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: Every pre-packaged food shall bear the name of the food on the Principal Display Panel which indicates the true nature of the food.
rules.description: True nature and description of the food (e.g. Granola) must appear prominently on the PDP.

rules.title: Mandatory Green Vegetarian Logo (Veg Mark)
rules.name: Mandatory Green Vegetarian Logo (Veg Mark)
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: Every package of 'Vegetarian Food' shall bear a declaration to this effect by a symbol in green colour consisting of a filled circle inside a square with green border.
rules.description: Vegetarian food must declare green square with filled green circle on PDP near product name.

rules.title: Metric Net Quantity Declaration
rules.name: Metric-Only Net Quantity Declaration
rules.sourceLaw: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.sourceQuote: The net quantity shall be stated in terms of standard units of weight or measure using metric units (g, kg, ml, l). The declaration shall not be accompanied by any qualifying words.
rules.description: Net quantity must be declared in metric units (g/kg). Primary US customary units (ounces) are strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP incl. of all taxes)
rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP incl. of all taxes)
rules.sourceLaw: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.sourceQuote: The retail sale price of the package shall clearly indicate that it is the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes, with the declaration: 'Maximum or Max. Retail Price Rs. or ₹ .... (inclusive of all taxes)'
rules.description: Mandatory MRP declaration in Indian Rupees inclusive of all taxes (e.g. MRP ₹ 450.00 incl. of all taxes).

rules.title: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration
rules.name: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration
rules.sourceLaw: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021
rules.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021, Rule 6(1)(m)
rules.sourceQuote: The unit sale price shall be declared on the package, in the case of packages containing commodity more than one kilogram or one litre, per kilogram or per litre, and if less than one kilogram or one litre, per gram or per 100 gram or per millilitre.
rules.description: Mandatory unit sale price (e.g. 'Unit Sale Price: ₹ 0.94 / g' or '₹ 93.75 / 100g') adjacent to MRP declaration.

rules.title: FSSAI Logo and 14-Digit Licence Identifier
rules.name: FSSAI Logo and 14-Digit License Number
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: The FSSAI logo and licence number of the manufacturer shall be displayed on the label of the food package in contrast colour to the background.
rules.description: FSSAI wordmark logo alongside 14-digit state/central license number on contrasting background.

rules.title: Consumer Care Contact Details
rules.name: Consumer Care / Grievance Redressal Contact
rules.sourceLaw: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.sourceQuote: The name, address, telephone number, email address of the person who can be contacted by the consumer, in case of consumer complaints, shall be declared on the package.
rules.description: Contact details of consumer grievance officer including name/designation, address, phone number, and email.

rules.title: Ingredient Declaration in Descending Order of Weight
rules.name: List of Ingredients in Descending Weight Order
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: The list of ingredients shall be headed or preceded by an appropriate title which consists of or includes the term 'Ingredients'. Ingredients shall be listed in descending order of their weight or volume at the time of manufacture.
rules.description: Ingredients must be listed in descending order of ingoing weight at time of manufacture.

rules.title: Nutritional Information per 100g and per Serve
rules.name: Nutritional Information Declaration per 100g and Per Serve
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: Nutritional Information or nutritional facts shall include: energy value (kcal), protein (g), carbohydrate (g) and total sugars (g), added sugars (g), total fat (g), saturated fat (g), trans fat (g), and sodium (mg) per 100g or per 100ml or per single consumption pack.
rules.description: Nutritional facts panel with energy, protein, carbohydrate, total sugars, added sugars, total fat, saturated fat, trans fat, and sodium.

rules.title: Per-Serve Percentage Contribution to Recommended Dietary Allowances (% RDA)
rules.name: Percentage Contribution to Recommended Dietary Allowances (% RDA)
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: The nutritional information per serve percentage contribution to Recommended Dietary Allowances (RDA) calculated on the basis of 2000 kcal energy shall be mentioned.
rules.description: Nutritional facts must show per-serve % RDA calculated against ICMR-NIN 2000 kcal reference.

rules.title: Food Allergen Declaration and Precautionary Warning
rules.name: Declaration of Allergens and Precautionary Cross-Contact
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: Allergens shall be declared separately under 'Contains ...' or highlighted in the ingredient list. The presence of cereals containing gluten, crustaceans, milk, eggs, fish, peanuts, tree nuts, soybeans, and sulphites (>10mg/kg) must be declared.
rules.description: Clear allergen statement ('Contains Tree Nuts [Almonds, Walnuts], Gluten') immediately below ingredient list.

rules.title: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer or Packer
rules.name: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer / Packer
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: The name and complete address of the manufacturer and the manufacturing unit if these are located at different places shall be declared on every package of food.
rules.description: Complete physical address of manufacturer and packing facility with PIN code.

rules.title: Date of Manufacture or Packaging Declaration
rules.name: Date of Manufacture or Packaging Declaration
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: The date, month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, packed or pre-packed, shall be declared on the label.
rules.description: Date of manufacture (Mfg Date: DD/MM/YYYY) or packing.

rules.title: Best Before or Expiry Date Declaration
rules.name: Best Before or Expiry Date Declaration
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: The 'Best Before' or 'Use by Date' or 'Expiry Date' shall be declared on the label. The 'Best Before' shall be stated in the manner 'Best before .... months from packaging/manufacture' or 'Best before [date]'.
rules.description: Mandatory 'Best Before' duration or expiry date.

rules.title: Batch, Lot or Code Number Identification
rules.name: Batch / Lot Identification Code
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: A batch number or code number or lot number shall be declared on the label.
rules.description: Batch or code number preceded by 'Batch No.' or 'Lot No.' or 'B. No.'

rules.title: Country of Origin Declaration
rules.name: Country of Origin Declaration
rules.sourceLaw: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.sourceQuote: In the case of packages containing imported goods, the name and address of the importer and the name of the country of origin or manufacture shall be mentioned on the package.
rules.description: Country of origin or manufacture (e.g. 'Country of Origin: USA') and importer details must be declared on imported goods.

rules.title: Batch / Lot Code Formatting and Visibility
rules.name: Batch / Lot Identification Code Formatting
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: A batch number or code number or lot number shall be declared on the label.
rules.description: Batch or code number must be preceded by 'Batch No.' or 'Lot No.' or 'B. No.'

rules.title: Specific Storage Conditions Instruction
rules.name: Storage Condition Instructions
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: Special conditions for the storage of the food shall be declared on the label if the validity of the date depends on such storage.
rules.description: Specific storage instructions required to maintain product quality (e.g. Store in cool, dry place away from direct sunlight).

rules.title: Advertising and Claims — Restriction on Sugar Claims When Sweeteners Added
rules.name: Restrictions on Sugar and Honey Claims
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018
rules.sourceQuote: A claim that a food is 'No Added Sugar' shall not be made if the food contains ingredients like honey, jaggery, or fruit juices that contribute sugars.
rules.description: Claims of 'No Added Sugars' are prohibited if the food contains ingredients like honey that contribute sugars.

rules.title: FSSAI Vegan Food Regulations & Statutory Vegan Logo Endorsement
rules.name: FSSAI Vegan Food Certification & Logo Endorsement
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Vegan Foods) Regulations, 2022
rules.sourceQuote: No person shall manufacture, pack, sell, offer for sale, market or distribute or import any food as vegan food unless they comply with the requirements laid down under these regulations and carry the vegan logo specified in the Schedule.
rules.description: Vegan food requires prior FSSAI approval to display statutory Vegan Logo. Private trust-mark shields are not legal proof under FSSAI.

rules.title: FSSAI 2027 FOPNL Indian Nutrition Rating (INR) Star Rating
rules.name: FSSAI 2027 FOPNL Indian Nutrition Rating (INR) Star Rating
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Amendment Regulations, 2026
rules.citation: FSSAI (Labelling and Display) Amendment Regulations 2027, Reg. 5(3)
rules.sourceQuote: Mandatory Front-of-Pack Nutrition Labelling (FOPNL) Indian Nutrition Rating (INR) star emblem (0.5 to 5 stars) and high-sugar/fat/sodium warning thresholds for packaged granola.
rules.description: Mandatory Front-of-Pack Nutrition Labelling (FOPNL) Indian Nutrition Rating (INR) star emblem (0.5 to 5 stars) and high-sugar/fat/sodium warning thresholds for packaged granola.
